optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Plant Procurement Manager, Industrial Gas Supply Network

professionalSummary.text: Eight years in plant procurement within heavy industry, including three years managing procurement activities for three plants under group policy
professionalSummary.witness: Five years in plant procurement at a regional cement producer, the last two as the buyer for three plants' maintenance parts and contracted services under the group procurement policy, reporting to the plant procurement team leader. candidate said he has 'eight years in procurement, all of it in heavy industry' and that he 'ran the procurement team for the plants'

experienceHighlights.text: Operated documented supplier risk process for critical parts across three plants, maintaining critical supplier register and conducting quarterly risk reviews with plant maintenance managers
experienceHighlights.witness: Operated the supplier risk process for the three plants' critical parts, keeping the critical supplier register and the quarterly risk review with the plant maintenance managers.

experienceHighlights.text: Wrote annual procurement boundary notes for each of three plants and closed two internal audit findings related to purchase order controls in 2024
experienceHighlights.witness: Wrote the annual procurement boundary note for each of the three plants and closed the two internal audit findings raised against the plants' purchase order controls in 2024.

experienceHighlights.text: Managed maintenance parts and contracted services buying for three plants under group procurement policy
experienceHighlights.witness: Five years in plant procurement at a regional cement producer, the last two as the buyer for three plants' maintenance parts and contracted services under the group procurement policy, reporting to the plant procurement team leader.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Prepared tender documents and bid comparison for kiln refurbishment capital equipment tender, supporting team leader's submission to group tender board
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Supported the capital equipment tenders run by the team leader for the kiln refurbishment, preparing the tender documents and the bid comparison; the tender board submissions were made by the team leader. candidate said he has 'eight years in procurement, all of it in heavy industry' and that he 'ran the procurement team for the plants'; asked about the kiln tender, he said the team leader 'fronted it at the board' but that the work was his.

skills.text: Procurement policy compliance, supplier risk management, capital equipment tender support, audit closure
skills.witness: Five years in plant procurement at a regional cement producer, the last two as the buyer for three plants' maintenance parts and contracted services under the group procurement policy, reporting to the plant procurement team leader. Operated the supplier risk process for the three plants' critical parts, keeping the critical supplier register and the quarterly risk review with the plant maintenance managers. Wrote the annual procurement boundary note for each of the three plants and closed the two internal audit findings raised against the plants' purchase order controls in 2024. Supported the capital equipment tenders run by the team leader for the kiln refurbishment, preparing the tender documents and the bid comparison; the tender board submissions were made by the team leader.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The materials establish eight years of plant procurement experience (five years at cement producer, two years as purchasing assistant, and one year implied from recruiter's 'eight years' statement), including three years managing procurement activities for three plants under group policy. The materials do not establish that the candidate ran a procurement team (only that they were the buyer for three plants) or that they ran capital equipment tenders above the group's delegated limit through the group tender board (only that they supported the team leader's submissions).

decisionBoundary.statement: Candidate meets most requirements but has partial evidence for running capital tenders and lacks evidence for running a procurement team.
